title: docs: policy.ts hasPassingCheck comment still says the ps1 wrapper records qualityGate verbatim
description:
Found by QA of task-8fc35d31 (completion f1399a3). That card makes scripts/moe-agent.ps1 trim settings.qualityGate where Read-MoeCommitSettings reads it (moe-agent.ps1:1980, `$qg.Trim()`), so both wrappers now run and record the trimmed command. Its approved plan limited it to five script files, so this daemon comment was out of its scope.

packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts:170-172 (hasPassingCheck doc comment, from bb5e7e2 / task-808869c5) still justifies the recorded-command trim with: "the ps1 wrapper records settings.qualityGate verbatim (the sh one trims it)". That is now false.

Keep the trim itself. It still protects CheckRun records written by a pre-fix ps1 wrapper and already on disk, an IDE plugin that still bundles the old wrapper, and any direct moe.record_check_run caller (recordCheckRun.ts:63 stores `command` verbatim). Only the stated reason is stale. Comment-only; no behaviour change.
definitionOfDone: packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts hasPassingCheck doc comment no longer claims either wrapper records settings.qualityGate verbatim, and names why the recorded-command trim stays (records written before task-8fc35d31, older bundled wrappers, direct record_check_run callers)
The diff changes only that comment (no code); the daemon build (npm run build in packages/moe-daemon) passes
